Interface Animatable

All Known Implementing Classes:
BlueberryCookie, BraveGingerbreadCookie, Cookie, NinjaCookie, PirateCookie, ZombieCookie
public interface Animatable
Interface for objects that have sprite-based frame animation. Implemented by Cookie (and any future animated characters).
